paragraphs.text: And he said unto me: ‘Observe, Enoch, these heavenly tablets, And read what is written thereon, And mark every individual fact.’
paragraphs.original: ወይቤለኒ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ነጽር፡ ውስተ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወአንብብ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ ኵሎ፡ በበ፡ ኪሉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbēlanī Henok naṣṣər wəsta ṣəlāta samāy wa-ʾanbəb zaṣəḥuf lāʿlēhomu wa-ʾaʾəməro kwəlo baba kilu

paragraphs.text: And I observed the heavenly tablets, and read everything which was written (thereon) and understood everything, and read the book of all the deeds of mankind, and of all the children of flesh that shall be upon the earth to the remotest generations. 3. And forthwith I blessed the great Lord the King of glory for ever, in that He has made all the works of the world, And I extolled the Lord because of His patience, And blessed Him because of the children of men.
paragraphs.original: ወነጸርኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወአንበብኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወአእመርኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወአንበብኩ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብረ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሥጋ፡ እለ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እስከ፡ ለትዉልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወባረክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ንጉሠ፡ ክብር፡ ዘገብረ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ዓለም፡ ወአእኮትክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በእንተ፡ ትዕግሥቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ውሉደ፡ አዳም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-naṣṣarku kwəlo ṣəlāta samāy wa-ʾanbabku kwəlo zaṣəḥuf lāʿlēhomu wa-ʾaʾəmarku kwəlo wa-ʾanbabku maṣḥafa kwəlu gəbra sabʾ wa-kwəlu wəluda śəgā ʾəlla yəkawwənu lāʿla mədr ʾəska la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam wa-bārakəwwo la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr nəguśa kəbr zagabra kwəlo gəbra ʿālam wa-ʾaʾəkotku-wwo la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr ba-ʾənta təʿgəśtu lāʿla wəluda ʾAdām

paragraphs.text: And after that I said: ‘Blessed is the man who dies in righteousness and goodness, Concerning whom there is no book of unrighteousness written, And against whom no day of judgement shall be found.’
paragraphs.original: ወእቤ፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ብፁዕ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይመውት፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወሠናይ፡ ዘዘፍርደ፡ ኢተጽሕፈ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወዘዕለተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ኢተረክበ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəbē baba gizēhu bəḍuʿ zawəʾətu bəʾsi zayəmawwət ṣādəq wa-śannāy zaza-fərda ʾitaṣəḥfa lāʿlēhu wa-zaʿəlata kwənanē ʾitarakba

paragraphs.text: And those seven holy ones brought me and placed me on the earth before the door of my house, and said to me: ‘Declare everything to thy son Methuselah, and show to all thy children that no flesh is righteous in the sight of the Lord, for He is their Creator. 6. One year we will leave thee with thy son, till thou givest thy (last) commands, that thou mayst teach thy children and record (it) for them, and testify to all thy children; and in the second year they shall take thee from their midst.
paragraphs.original: ወእልክቱ፡ ሰብዐቱ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ አምጽኡኒ፡ ወአንበሩኒ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ቅድመ፡ ዐጸዱ፡ ለቤትየ፡ ወይቤሉኒ፡ ንግሮሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለወልድከ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ወአርኢ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ከመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያስተበቍዕ፡ ሥጋ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ፡ ፈጣሪ፡ ውእቱ፡ አሐደ፡ ዓመተ፡ እንኅድግከ፡ ምስለ፡ ውሉድከ፡ እስከ፡ ታጸንዕ፡ ዳግመ፡ ወትምህር፡ ውሉደከ፡ ወትጽሕፍ፡ ሎሙ፡ ወትሰምዕ፡ ሎሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወትዜንዎሙ፡ ለውሉደ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ካዕበ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəlləktu sabʿatu qəddusān ʾamṣəʾuni wa-ʾanbaru-ni lāʿla mədr qədma ʿaḍadu la-bētəya wa-yəbēlu-ni nəgəromu kwəlo la-waldə-ka Mātusālā wa-ʾarʾi la-kwəlomu wəlud-ka kama ʾalbo zayāstabaqqwəʿ śəgā qədmēhu la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr ʾəsma faṭāri wəʾətu ʾaḥada ʿāmata ʾənḫədəggə-ka məsla wəlud-ka ʾəska tāṣannəʿ dāgəma wa-təməhər wəluda-ka wa-təṣəḥf lomu wa-təsamməʿ lomu kwəlo wa-təzēnəwwomu la-wəluda wəlud-ka kāʿba

paragraphs.text: Let thy heart be strong, For the good shall announce righteousness to the good; The righteous with the righteous shall rejoice, And shall offer congratulation to one another.
paragraphs.original: ወበአመ፡ ካልዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ይትነሥኡከ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ወልብከ፡ ይጸንዕ፡ እስመ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ዘጻድቀ፡ ኆሊቆሙ፡ ይከውን፡ ወኃጥአን፡ ይትኄሰሱ፡ ለበበ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾama kāləʿ ʿāmat yətnaśśəʾu-ka ʾəmənna mədr qədmēhomu wa-ləbbə-ka yəṣannəʿ ʾəsma ṣādəqān zaṣādəqa ḫolaqomu yəkawwən wa-ḫāṭəʾān yətḫēsasu laba-ḫāṭiʾatomu

paragraphs.text: But the sinners shall die with the sinners, And the apostate go down with the apostate.
paragraphs.original: ወዘይፈቅድ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡ ይፈጽም፡ ሎሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ሠናየ፡ እንበለ፡ ሐሰት፡ ወእንበለ፡ ኃጢአት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-zayəfaqqəd ṣādəq laba-gizēhomu yəfaṣṣəm lomu kwəlo gəbra śannāya ʾənbala ḥassat wa-ʾənbala ḫāṭiʾat

paragraphs.text: And those who practise righteousness shall die on account of the deeds of men, And be taken away on account of the doings of the godless.’
paragraphs.original: ብዙኃን፡ ኀጥአን፡ ይተኀጐሉ፡ በውስተ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ፡ እስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ይኩን፡ ጻድቀ፡
paragraphs.translit: bəzuḫān ḫāṭəʾān yətaḫaggwalu ba-wəsta ḫāṭiʾatomu ʾəska kwəlu gəbromu ṣādəqān yəkun ṣādəqa

paragraphs.text: And in those days they ceased to speak to me, and I came to my people, blessing the Lord of the world.
paragraphs.original: ወይእዜ፡ ወልድየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘንተ፡ እነግረከ፡ ወእጽሕፈከ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ኵሎ፡ ከሠትኩ፡ ለከ፡ ወአንሣእኩ፡ ለከ፡ ለመጽሐፍት፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኵሉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəʾəzē waldə-ya kwəlo zanta ʾənaggərə-ka wa-ʾəṣəḥfa-ka kiyāhu kwəlo kaśatku la-ka wa-ʾansāʾəku la-ka la-maṣaḥəft kiyāhomu kwəlu
